name: spec-extract
description: Agnostic extraction framework: turns a React/Tailwind prototype (source + built html) into a product-requirements delta. One config per app.

scripts.delta: node src/census.mjs --version $npm_config_to && node src/diff.mjs --from $npm_config_from --to $npm_config_to && node src/plan.mjs --from $npm_config_from --to $npm_config_to
